result.title: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver
result.summary: Classical structure-from-motion reconstruction proceeds iteratively, refining camera poses and scene geometry from a current estimate. This allows maps to easily expand without recomputing already computed views, or geometry estimates to improve as more observations are provided. Most geometric foundation models, however, predict entire geometry in a single forward pass or update a recurrent state as frames arrive sequentially, making this expansion and refinement non-trivial. We introduce Solv3R, a looped transformer that learns to continue solving multi-view geometry from its current state. Importantly, its update operator is independent of the iteration count, allowing previously refined and newly introduced views to be jointly updated regardless of how ``solved'' they are. We train the operator to preserve accurate reconstructions under continued iteration and correct inaccurate states, enabling refinement of fixed image collections and integration of new observations. Representations of solved views can also be cached once and reused as geometric context across iterations, enabling compact and efficient key-value caching. We analyze the solver dynamics and compare it with the state-of-the-art, demonstrating that a single learned solver supports offline reconstruction, incremental reconstruction, relocalization, and streaming without task-specific training or modules. The code and models will be made publicly available at https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/.

AI.brief_summary: Solv3R 提出一种循环 Transformer 几何求解器，从当前多视图状态迭代更新相机位姿与场景几何，并支持离线、增量、重定位和流式重建。
AI.relevance_reason: 其与迭代次数无关的循环更新、已解视图表示的缓存复用，以及持续迭代下保持准确状态并纠正错误状态，可作为 LVR 中循环 latent 状态更新、缓存与长度泛化的方法线索，但迁移到 VLM 推理尚需核查。
